data.name: Nitesh Sharma
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Nitesh Sharma has made a big mark in cricket. With 19 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 17, with an average of 5.43 and a quick strike rate of 73.08. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 1 sixes and 2 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 29.4 overs, taking 17 wickets at an economy rate of 8.12. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
